items.zh: 我___三十岁了，不是小孩子了。
items.en: I am already thirty. I am not a child any more.

items.zh: 我走在路上，___看见了一只小狗。
items.en: I was walking along the road when I suddenly saw a puppy.

items.zh: 他学了三年，___会说汉语了。
items.en: He studied for three years and can finally speak Chinese.

items.zh: 从这里___往前走，就是银行。
items.en: Go straight ahead from here and you will reach the bank.

R3.zh: 小明昨天晚上看比赛看到十二点，他今天早上八点才起床，所以上课迟到了。
R3.en: Xiao Ming watched a match until twelve yesterday evening and he only got up at eight this morning, so he was late for class.

q.zh: 小明今天为什么迟到了？
q.en: Why was Xiao Ming late today?

R3.zh: 我很喜欢我们的新邻居。他们常常给我们送水果，我们也请他们来家里吃饭。
R3.en: I like our new neighbours very much. They often bring us fruit, and we invite them to eat at our home too.

q.zh: 他们和邻居的关系怎么样？
q.en: How is their relationship with the neighbours?

R3.zh: 这家银行星期一到星期五上午九点开门，下午五点关门，星期六只开半天，星期天不开。
R3.en: This bank opens at nine in the morning and closes at five in the afternoon from Monday to Friday, is open only half a day on Saturday and does not open on Sunday.

q.en: What about the bank on Sunday?

R3.zh: 我的朋友今年二十五岁，她不但会说汉语，而且汉字写得很漂亮。
R3.en: My friend is twenty-five this year. She can not only speak Chinese but also writes characters beautifully.

q.en: How well does she write characters?

R3.zh: 快过年了，商店里人很多。我妈妈买了很多菜和水果，她说要请朋友来家里吃饭。
R3.en: The New Year is coming and the shops are full of people. My mother bought a lot of vegetables and fruit. She said she wants to invite friends to eat at home.

q.zh: 妈妈为什么买了很多菜？
q.en: Why did Mother buy a lot of vegetables?

R3.zh: 昨天我去商店买东西，发现手机不在包里了。我很着急，后来才知道，手机在办公室。
R3.en: Yesterday I went shopping and found that my phone was not in my bag. I was very worried, and only later did I find out that it was in the office.

R3.zh: 今天的天气太热了，我们不想出去，所以在家一边吃西瓜，一边看电视。
R3.en: The weather is too hot today and we did not want to go out, so we stayed at home eating watermelon and watching TV.

R3.zh: 老师说，学汉语最重要的是多说、多听、多写。只看书不太好。
R3.en: The teacher says that the most important thing in learning Chinese is to speak more, listen more and write more. Only reading books is not very good.

q.zh: 老师觉得怎么学汉语才好？
q.en: How does the teacher think one should learn Chinese?

R3.zh: 我的邻居每天都骑自行车上班，他说骑车可以锻炼身体，也不用花钱。
R3.en: My neighbour cycles to work every day. He says cycling can give him exercise and also costs nothing.

q.zh: 邻居为什么骑自行车上班？
q.en: Why does the neighbour cycle to work?

opts: 可以锻炼身体，也不用花钱

R3.zh: 你好，我是小明。我的电脑坏了，下午你有时间帮我看一看吗？
R3.en: Hello, this is Xiao Ming. My computer is broken. Do you have time this afternoon to take a look at it for me?

q.en: What does Xiao Ming want someone to do?

R3.zh: 这个周末我们学校有运动会，我参加了跑步比赛。
R3.en: Our school has a sports meeting this weekend. I am taking part in the running race.

R3.zh: 妈妈给我买了两件衬衫，一大一小。大的太大了，所以我今天穿小的。
R3.en: Mother bought me two shirts, one big and one small. The big one is too big, so I am wearing the small one today.

q.en: Which shirt is he wearing today?

R3.zh: 昨天我和朋友去看了一个电影，电影很长，我们看了三个小时，所以回家以后很累。
R3.en: Yesterday a friend and I went to see a film. It was very long, three hours, so we were tired when we got home.

R3.zh: 我哥哥的房间很小，但是很干净。他每天回家以后先打扫房间，然后再做饭。
R3.en: My older brother's room is small but very clean. Every day after he gets home he first cleans the room and then cooks.

q.zh: 哥哥回家以后先做什么？
q.en: What does the older brother do first after getting home?

R3.zh: 每个星期天，爷爷都带我去公园。他在公园里和朋友们一起唱歌，我在旁边玩。
R3.en: Every Sunday, Grandpa takes me to the park. He sings with his friends in the park while I play nearby.

q.en: What does Grandpa do in the park?

R3.zh: 我在南方长大，那里冬天不太冷。去年我来到北方，这里冬天常常下雪，我很不习惯。
R3.en: I grew up in the south, where the winter is not too cold. Last year I came to the north, where it often snows in winter, and I am not used to it.

q.zh: 他为什么不习惯北方的冬天？
q.en: Why is he not used to the winter in the north?
